annotations.title: Show my plan and Horizon Units

description:
Use this when the user wants to know where their RipClip account stands: "how many Horizon Units do I have
        left", "what plan am I on", "when do my units refill", "what does a minute of video cost". Returns the plan
        name, the units left and the plan's monthly units, the longest video it takes, when the units refill or the
        plan renews, and how many units one minute of video takes (rates by length with a worked example, never
        prices). It also links the billing page, where only the user changes the plan. No parameters.
        Not for: the cost of one particular video (estimate_hu), clip or post numbers (get_account_stats), or
        changing the plan. Free and read only. Next: estimate_hu before find_clips.
name: get_my_plan
